notes: MACHINE-GENERATED, UNREVIEWED (RX-30). review_status is 'beta' and reviewer is null: no human linguistic review has happened, so every string here renders the beta and machine-translated truthfulness chips. A null value with status 'pending' is the honest record that no confident translation exists for that key; it is counted as absent by packages/i18n/COVERAGE.json and must not be filled with a plausible-looking guess. Text between the U+2772 and U+2773 markers is a PROTECTED SPAN (RX-29) and must be re-emitted byte-identically - do not translate, transliterate, case-fold or reorder it.

nav.workspaces.description: Navigation label, /workspaces route (RX-20). Plural noun; a workspace contains projects.

nav.sources.description: Navigation label, /sources route (RX-20). Input data and notebooks, not literature references.

nav.studio.description: Navigation label, /studio route (RX-20). The editing surface where an analysis is inspected and repaired. A product-surface name; keep it short.

nav.lineage.description: Navigation label, /lineage route (RX-20). Which inputs and steps produced which outputs - data provenance, not biological descent.

nav.repairs.description: Navigation label, /repairs route (RX-20). Proposed changes to a broken analysis, awaiting approval.

nav.contracts.description: Navigation label, /contracts route (RX-20). A result contract declares what a run must produce and within what tolerance. Not a legal agreement.

nav.runs.description: Navigation label, /runs route (RX-20). One execution of an analysis.

nav.evidence.description: Navigation label, /evidence route (RX-20). Stored artefacts that support or refuse a verification outcome.

nav.wiki.description: Navigation label, /wiki route (RX-20). Keep the loanword if it is the established term in the target language.

nav.connectors.description: Navigation label, /connectors route (RX-20). Integrations with external data systems.

outcome.reproduced_within_contract.description: VerificationOutcome REPRODUCED_WITHIN_CONTRACT. MUST match docs/UX.md exactly. NEVER shorten to 'Reproduced' and never render as 'verified', 'validated' or 'passed': RETRACE establishes conformance to a declared contract, not correctness, and dropping the qualifier converts a conformance statement into a correctness claim (docs/security/T10_REVIEW.md control 1). The qualifier must stay inseparable from the label in every language. Left pending until a human linguist signs off.

outcome.executed_not_verified.description: VerificationOutcome EXECUTED_NOT_VERIFIED: the analysis ran, but no verification was performed. The negation carries the meaning and must not be softened.

outcome.changed_result.description: VerificationOutcome CHANGED_RESULT: the output differs from the reference, or the method changed even though the numbers agree.

outcome.blocked_missing_evidence.description: VerificationOutcome BLOCKED_MISSING_EVIDENCE: no outcome could be reached because required evidence is absent. Not a failure of the analysis.

outcome.failed_execution.description: VerificationOutcome FAILED_EXECUTION: the run itself did not complete.

truth.stale.value: ❲STALE❳ Los datos mostrados no están en directo.
truth.stale.description: Truthfulness chip for a disconnected stream (RX-25). The token inside the protected markers is a fixed machine-readable token: do not translate, case-fold, transliterate or reorder it. Translate only the sentence after it.

truth.unavailable.value: ❲UNAVAILABLE❳ No se puede acceder a esta fuente.
truth.unavailable.description: Truthfulness chip for an unreachable source (RX-25). Token protected - translate only the sentence.

truth.replay.value: ❲REPLAY❳ Historial grabado, no actividad en directo.
truth.replay.description: Truthfulness chip for replayed history (RX-25). Token protected - translate only the sentence.

truth.demo.value: ❲DEMO❳ Datos de prueba. No es una ejecución real.
truth.demo.description: Truthfulness chip for fixture data (RX-25). Token protected - translate only the sentences.

truth.beta.value: ❲beta❳ Traducido automáticamente y no revisado por un lingüista.
truth.beta.description: Truthfulness chip shown on every unreviewed locale (RX-30). The lowercase token is deliberate and protected - translate only the sentence.

truth.needs_configuration.value: ❲NEEDS_CONFIGURATION❳ No hay ninguna credencial ni ajuste configurado.
truth.needs_configuration.description: Truthfulness chip for an unconfigured capability (RX-25). Token protected - translate only the sentence.

truth.synthetic.description: Truthfulness chip for generated values (RX-25). Token protected - translate only the sentence.

truth.injected.description: Truthfulness chip for system-added content (RX-25). The lowercase token is deliberate and protected.

truth.machine_translated.value: ❲machine-translated❳ No se ha realizado ninguna revisión lingüística humana.
truth.machine_translated.description: Truthfulness chip for machine translation (RX-30). Token protected - translate only the sentence.

field.notebook_path.description: Form field label. A snapshot-relative file path.

field.dataset_digest.description: Form field label. The algorithm name is a protected span: it is an identifier, not a word (RX-29).

field.tolerance.description: Form field label. How far an output may differ from the reference and still conform.

field.timezone.description: Form field label. The standard's name is a protected span (RX-29). Storage is always UTC (RX-31).

field.random_seed.description: Form field label. The value that makes a stochastic analysis repeatable.

field.retention_days.description: Form field label. The unit is a protected span so it is never translated into an ambiguous abbreviation (RX-29).

validation.required.description: Validation message. {field} is substituted with a translated field label, so the sentence must read correctly with a noun phrase in that position.

validation.digest_format.description: Validation message. Keep the number 64 and the protected algorithm name exactly (RX-29).

validation.tolerance_range.description: Validation message. {min} and {max} are numbers formatted for the locale.

validation.path_not_relative.description: Validation message (RX-06). The traversal token is a protected span: it is syntax, not punctuation (RX-29).

validation.email_format.value: Introduce una dirección de correo electrónico válida.

validation.known_limits_required.description: Validation message (RX-03). A result contract must admit what it cannot establish before it can be approved; this refusal is deliberate and must not read as a transient error.

error.run_failed.value: La ejecución falló antes de producir una salida.

error.evidence_missing.description: Error state (RX-37). Abstaining is the correct behaviour here, not a bug.

error.permission_denied.value: No tienes permiso para ver esto.

error.offline.value: Sin conexión. Nada de lo que se muestra aquí está en directo.

error.rate_limited.description: Error state (RX-51). {seconds} is a number; the sentence must stay grammatical for 1 and for many - use a neutral phrasing if the language needs one.

error.budget_exceeded.description: Error state (RX-35). {budget} is substituted with a budget name such as tokens, requests, time or cost.

notify.run_complete.description: Notification. The run identifier is a protected span: the placeholder resolves to an opaque identifier that must not be reflowed or reordered (RX-29, RX-28).

notify.repair_proposed.description: Notification. The notebook path is a protected span (RX-29).

notify.approval_required.value: Se requiere aprobación antes de aplicar esta reparación.

notify.approval_invalidated.description: Notification (RX-05). An approval binds one exact candidate; any change voids it.

notify.export_ready.value: El paquete de evidencias está listo para descargar.

help.tolerance.description: Help text. Keep the warning blunt; this is the second-order exposure recorded in docs/security/T10_REVIEW.md.

help.protected_spans.description: Help text (RX-29). The standard's name is itself a protected span. If the target language needs a different plural form around it, reword so the token stands alone rather than altering it.

help.conformance_not_correctness.description: Help text. The central honest limitation (docs/security/T10_REVIEW.md). Do not soften 'does not' into 'may not' or 'cannot fully'.

consent.data_processing.description: Consent copy. Both sentences are commitments; neither may be dropped or hedged.

consent.telemetry.description: Consent copy. Opt-in wording; must not imply the choice is already made.

consent.withdraw.description: Consent copy. The second sentence is a limitation and must be kept.

invite.body.description: Invitation copy, body. Three placeholders; keep all three.

email.subject.run_complete.description: Email subject. The identifier is protected; {outcome} resolves to one of the five outcome labels, which must not be shortened.

email.body.run_complete.description: Email body. Mentioning the limitations is required, not optional (RX-15).

email.body.invitation.description: Email body. The single-use statement must be kept.

a11y.skip_to_content.description: Accessibility label for the skip link.

a11y.close_panel.description: Accessibility label for a panel close control.

a11y.sort_column.description: Accessibility label for a sortable column header.

a11y.outcome_icon.description: Accessibility label read instead of the outcome icon. Colour is never the carrier of state (RX-25), so this text must carry the full label.

a11y.loading.description: Accessibility label for a busy region.

export.generated_at.description: Export chrome. The timestamp renders in the viewer's zone from UTC storage (RX-31) and is protected so it is never reordered inside right-to-left text (RX-28).
